d.head: 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70
d.gap: PersistentRuntimeService is START_STICKY and unconditionally advertises READY even though FoldOverlayService owns the actual controller and can be destroyed/disabled without stopping or downgrading the persistent runtime.
d.boundary: Foreground runtime start/stop/restart/status ownership only; excludes cover-lease process recovery, angle arbitration, overflow, presentation, sensor access and production writes.
d.firstAction: Executable lifecycle model proving orphan READY and defining READY/RECOVERING/stopped contract.
